svg.title: Phase plane of the FitzHugh-Nagumo model with membrane potential u horizontally and recovery variable w vertically: the cubic nullcline w = u - u^3/3, the line w = (u + 0.7)/0.8, the resting state at their intersection, several trajectories with arrows, and FitzHugh's region labels (resting, quasi-threshold, self-excitatory, regenerative, active, absolutely refractory, relatively refractory, hyperpolarized, depolarized, no man's land).
